evals.js: const C=moire.cells,d=moire.gpu.device;const {readBuffer}=await import('./src/snapshot.js');const ab=await readBuffer(d,C.cellBuf,0,C.count*384);const u=new Uint32Array(ab),f=new Float32Array(ab);let s=[0,0,0,0],n=[0,0,0,0];const b=await moire.organ.read();const out=b.map(L=>{let w=0,k=0,bat=0;for(const p of L){const o=p.i*96;for(let q=0;q<6;q++){const word=u[o+68+(q>>2)];const byte=(word>>>(8*(q&3)))&255;w+=byte/255*8;k++;}bat+=f[o+16];}return {n:L.length,wadh:+(w/Math.max(1,k)).toFixed(3),bat:+(bat/Math.max(1,L.length)).toFixed(3)}});const c=await moire.organ.measure();return JSON.stringify({out,L:c.length,W:c.width,j:c.junctions})
